L1.opening: A-Ze picks up an old talisman outside the temple. A mountain path appears on the paper. A voice calls from the hills, but the Tiger Guardian pins down the red cord and refuses to let him pass.
Cries from the old settlement reach the mountain. Yu-an opens the Shenlu. The clouded leopard she calls stops beside a torn talisman; as its paw approaches, the serpent markings light up.
Red sand veils the Nile crossing. Karim spreads the Shenlu on the stone steps. Before learning the cost, he promises to give his strength to the party.
A red shadow erases a line from the book of names, while people remain stranded on the riverbank. Salma stops writing and turns to Bastet.

Einar once turned a safe journey home into a song about a lone hero. He left out fear and losing the way, believing that such a song would give everyone courage. Now someone at the village gate is singing it as an order.
The dream of shattered planks still clings to Ingrid. She is urged to keep everyone behind, but Skadi points to the forest path beside the fjord: a route they can still take tonight.
